simple.meaning: עָגַן (ʻâgan) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to debar , i.e. from marriage.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ruth, beginning at Ruth 1:13. The surrounding contexts include family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָגַן (H5702) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: עָגַן (ʻâgan) / H5702 is traced through Ruth 1:13 with source-language evidence and verse context.
